say:1:1330373001:1.text: Dura above, look at me. I'm just a poor wretch longing to learn how to cook.
say:1:1330373001:1.source_cn: 哦老天哪，看看我，我只是一个想学做菜的可怜人。

say:3:1330373003:1.text: I asked her to take me on as an apprentice, but she turned me down flat.
say:3:1330373003:1.source_cn: 我想向她拜师学艺，她却完全不肯收留我。
